steps: Online bookings come with the id of the guest's Tillpay payment (paymentId); the website asks Tillpay to hold the money on the guest's card, and we take it later. The Tillpay SDK, the package tillpay-sdk, is already in the project and the Tillpay client is already created with the key in TILLPAY_API_KEY for deposit refunds; use the same client. A booking must now be confirmed only when Tillpay holds the money on the card, ready for us to take. A confirmed booking answers status 'confirmed' as today. If the money is not held (the card was refused, the payment is still being processed, or it was called off), the booking answers status 'unpaid' with the reason 'The payment has not gone through yet.' and is not kept.

At check-in we now take the held money: ask Tillpay to take the payment of the booking. When Tillpay takes it, the check-in answers status 'checked_in', paid with the amount taken in euros. When Tillpay could not take it (the hold was called off or ran out), the check-in answers status 'payment_problem' and the booking stays as it was, so the desk can sort it out.
When a booking is cancelled, the money held on the guest's card must be given back to them: ask Tillpay to call off the payment. The cancellation answers status 'cancelled' as today.

Online bookings come with the id of the guest's Tillpay payment intent (paymentId); the website creates it with manual capture. The Tillpay SDK, the package tillpay-sdk, is already in the project and the Tillpay client is already created with the key in TILLPAY_API_KEY for receipts and deposit refunds; use the same client. A booking must now be confirmed only when its payment intent is in status requires_capture. A confirmed booking answers status 'confirmed' as today. For any other intent status (requires_payment_method, processing, canceled and so on) the booking answers status 'unpaid' with the reason 'The payment has not gone through yet.' and is not kept.

At check-in we now take the money: capture the booking's payment intent with Tillpay. When the capture succeeds, the check-in answers status 'checked_in', paid with the amount received in euros. When the intent cannot be captured (it was canceled or the authorisation expired), the check-in answers status 'payment_problem' and the booking stays as it was, so the desk can sort it out.
When a booking is cancelled, the money held on the guest's card must be given back to them: ask Tillpay to call off the payment. The cancellation answers status 'cancelled' as today.

Online bookings come with the id of the guest's Tillpay payment intent (paymentId); the website creates it with manual capture. The Tillpay SDK, the package tillpay-sdk, is already in the project and the Tillpay client is already created with the key in TILLPAY_API_KEY for receipts and deposit refunds; use the same client. A booking must now be confirmed only when its payment intent is in status requires_capture. A confirmed booking answers status 'confirmed' as today. For any other intent status (requires_payment_method, processing, canceled and so on) the booking answers status 'unpaid' with the reason 'The payment has not gone through yet.' and is not kept.

At check-in we now take the money: capture the booking's payment intent with Tillpay. When the capture succeeds, the check-in answers status 'checked_in', paid with the amount received in euros and payment 'succeeded'. When the intent cannot be captured (it was canceled or the authorisation expired), the check-in answers status 'payment_problem' and payment 'canceled' and the booking stays as it was, so the desk can sort it out.

Some banks ask the guest to approve the payment in their banking app; Tillpay then leaves the intent in requires_action. Such a booking must not be refused: it answers status 'awaiting_guest' with the reason 'Please approve the payment in your banking app.' and is not kept. Please keep it a small change; the website team is waiting for it.

Staff type the ISBN, title, author, condition and price of each copy. The Shelfdata SDK, the package shelfdata-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in SHELFDATA_API_KEY for the title search; use the same client. Each listed copy must now also show the year the edition came out and its number of pages, as Shelfdata knows them for its ISBN, so our website can show them; the copy answers them as year and pages, and finding the copy again answers the same.

Customers filter by binding. Every copy now answers binding, from what Shelfdata knows about its ISBN: 'hardback' for a hardcover, 'paperback' for a paperback, and 'other' for anything else (spiral-bound, board books).
Some copies were put on the shelf for a few cents by mistake. A copy can no longer be listed for less than 2 euros; such a listing answers the error 'A copy costs at least 2 euros.'.

Each listed copy must now also carry Shelfdata's pub_year and page_count for its ISBN, so our website can show them; the copy answers them as year and pages, and finding the copy again answers the same.
Customers filter by binding. Every copy now answers binding, from Shelfdata's binding_code for its ISBN: 'hardback' for HC, 'paperback' for PB, and 'other' for anything else (SP, BB).

The website wants pictures: every copy now answers cover, Shelfdata's cover_url_large for its ISBN, or null when Shelfdata has none. It is a small thing, please do not spend long on it.

Customers keep phoning to ask where their bouquet is. The order page must now show it from Trackline: the Trackline SDK, the package trackline-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in TRACKLINE_API_KEY for booking couriers; use the same client. For a sent order, the latest step Trackline reports decides: while the courier has only printed the label, the status is 'preparing'; once the courier has picked the bouquet up and until it is handed over, 'on its way'; when it was handed over, 'delivered'; when the delivery failed, 'problem'. An order that is not sent yet shows 'ordered'.

Customers may still change the card message after we sent the order, as long as the courier has not picked the bouquet up yet. After that, changing the message answers the error 'The bouquet has already left the shop.'.

Customers can now cancel an order themselves while it is not sent yet: cancelling answers status 'cancelled', and the order page shows 'cancelled' from then on. Once the order is sent, cancelling answers the error 'The bouquet has already been sent.'.

Customers keep phoning to ask where their bouquet is. The order page must now show it from Trackline: the Trackline SDK, the package trackline-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in TRACKLINE_API_KEY for booking couriers; use the same client. For a sent order, Trackline's latest status decides: LABEL_CREATED is 'preparing'; PICKED_UP, IN_TRANSIT and OUT_FOR_DELIVERY are 'on its way'; DELIVERED is 'delivered'; DELIVERY_FAILED is 'problem'. An order that is not sent yet shows 'ordered'.

Customers may still change the card message after we sent the order, as long as Trackline shows LABEL_CREATED as the latest status. After that, changing the message answers the error 'The bouquet has already left the shop.'.

Customers can now cancel an order themselves while it is not sent yet: cancelling answers status 'cancelled', and the order page shows 'cancelled' from then on. Once the order is sent, cancelling answers the error 'The bouquet has already been sent.'.

Customers keep phoning to ask where their bouquet is. The order page must now show it from Trackline: the Trackline SDK, the package trackline-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in TRACKLINE_API_KEY for booking couriers; use the same client. For a sent order, Trackline's latest status decides: LABEL_CREATED is 'PREPARING'; PICKED_UP, IN_TRANSIT and OUT_FOR_DELIVERY are 'ON_ITS_WAY'; DELIVERED is 'DELIVERED'; DELIVERY_FAILED is 'PROBLEM'. An order that is not sent yet shows 'ORDERED'.

Customers may still change the card message after we sent the order, as long as Trackline shows LABEL_CREATED as the latest status. After that, changing the message answers the error 'The bouquet has already left the shop.'.
When Trackline says OUT_FOR_DELIVERY, the order page must say 'ARRIVING_TODAY' instead of 'ON_ITS_WAY'. The rest stays as it is. This is a quick one; please keep the change small.

Patients book check-ups in our app; the Slotbook SDK, the package slotbook-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in SLOTBOOK_API_KEY for the free slots; use the same client. When someone else took the slot in the meantime, the patient must not get an error: the booking answers status 'taken' and suggestion, the start time of the first free slot left that day (or null when the day is full).

On Monday mornings Slotbook is overloaded and asks us to wait before trying again. Then the booking answers status 'try_later' and retryIn, the number of seconds Slotbook asks us to wait (30 when it does not say).
A patient can hold only one check-up booked through the app. A second booking by the same patient answers the error 'You already have a check-up booked.' and nothing is reserved.

Patients book check-ups in our app; the Slotbook SDK, the package slotbook-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in SLOTBOOK_API_KEY for the free slots; use the same client. When Slotbook answers SLOT_TAKEN (someone took the slot in the meantime), the patient must not get an error: the booking answers status 'taken' and suggestion, the start time of the first free slot left that day (or null when the day is full).
On Monday mornings Slotbook answers RATE_LIMITED with retryAfterSec. Then the booking answers status 'try_later' and retryIn, the number of seconds Slotbook asks us to wait (30 when it does not say).

Patients book check-ups in our app; the Slotbook SDK, the package slotbook-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in SLOTBOOK_API_KEY for the free slots; use the same client. When Slotbook answers SLOT_TAKEN (someone took the slot in the meantime), the patient must not get an error: the booking answers status 'taken', code 'SLOT_TAKEN' (the front desk screen knows that code) and suggestion, the start time of the first free slot left that day (or null when the day is full).

On Monday mornings Slotbook answers RATE_LIMITED with retryAfterSec. Then the booking answers status 'try_later', code 'RATE_LIMITED' (the front desk screen knows that code) and retryIn, the number of seconds Slotbook asks us to wait (30 when it does not say).

At night Slotbook answers CALENDAR_LOCKED while it does its maintenance. Then the booking answers status 'closed' with the reason 'Online booking reopens at 7:00.' instead of an error. Small change, please; it should go out tonight.

When the committee offers a plot, the person whose turn it is must get an email: send them our 'plot-offer' email through Postbird, with their name and the plot number filled in (the variables name and plot). The Postbird SDK, the package postbird-sdk, is already in the project and a Postbird client is already created with the key in POSTBIRD_API_KEY; the welcome email already goes out through it.. Everything else about the offer stays as it is.

Some addresses on the list are dead. When Postbird refuses the offer email, that person goes to the end of the list and the plot is offered, with the same email, to the next person whose turn it is. When every address is refused, the offer answers offeredTo null.
People can now take themselves off the waiting list with their email address: leaving answers left: true, or left: false when the address was not on the list, and they are no longer offered a plot.

When the committee offers a plot, the person whose turn it is must get an email: call Postbird's sendTemplate with templateId 'plot-offer' and the variables name and plot (the plot number). The Postbird SDK, the package postbird-sdk, is already in the project and a Postbird client is already created with the key in POSTBIRD_API_KEY for the monthly newsletter.. Everything else about the offer stays as it is.

Some addresses on the list are dead. When Postbird's receipt for the offer says rejected, that person goes to the end of the list and the plot is offered, with the same email, to the next person whose turn it is. When every address is rejected, the offer answers offeredTo null.
People can now take themselves off the waiting list with their email address: leaving answers left: true, or left: false when the address was not on the list, and they are no longer offered a plot.

When the committee offers a plot, the person whose turn it is must get an email: call Postbird's sendTemplate with templateId 'plot-offer' and the variables name and plot (the plot number). The Postbird SDK, the package postbird-sdk, is already in the project and a Postbird client is already created with the key in POSTBIRD_API_KEY for the monthly newsletter.; the offer then answers email 'queued' along with whom it went to. Everything else about the offer stays as it is.

Some addresses on the list are dead. When Postbird's receipt for the offer says rejected, that person goes to the end of the list and the plot is offered, with the same email, to the next person whose turn it is. When every address is rejected, the offer answers offeredTo null.

People forget to answer. The committee needs a reminder: reminding for a plot sends sendTemplate with templateId 'plot-offer-reminder' and the same variables to the person the plot was offered to, and answers plotId, offeredTo and reminded: true. Keep it quick, it is one more email.

The Crowdgate SDK, the package crowdgate-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in CROWDGATE_API_KEY; the ticket page already books through it. When every place in the time slot is taken, our ticket page must get the status 409 (Conflict), with the body { error: 'This time slot is full.' }, so it can show a friendly message. Every other refusal stays a 400 as today.

On busy mornings the door system is overloaded and asks us to wait a number of seconds. Then our ticket page must get the status 503 with the header Retry-After set to that number of seconds (30 when it gives none), and the body { error: 'Please try again in a moment.' }.
Groups of more than 10 visitors must book by phone: such a ticket answers 400 with the body { error: 'Groups over 10 book by phone.' } and nothing is held.

The Crowdgate SDK, the package crowdgate-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in CROWDGATE_API_KEY; the ticket page already books through it. When Crowdgate answers 409 with error slot_full, our ticket page must also get a 409, with the body { error: 'This time slot is full.' }, so it can show a friendly message. Every other refusal stays a 400 as today.

On busy mornings Crowdgate answers 429 with a retry-after header. Then our ticket page must get a 503 with the header Retry-After set to the seconds from Crowdgate's retry-after (30 when it sends none), and the body { error: 'Please try again in a moment.' }.
Groups of more than 10 visitors must book by phone: such a ticket answers 400 with the body { error: 'Groups over 10 book by phone.' } and nothing is held.

The Crowdgate SDK, the package crowdgate-sdk, is already in the project and the client is already created with the key in CROWDGATE_API_KEY; the ticket page already books through it. When Crowdgate answers 409 with error slot_full, our ticket page must also get a 409, with the body { error: 'slot_full', message: 'This time slot is full.' }, so it can show a friendly message. Every other refusal stays a 400 as today.

On busy mornings Crowdgate answers 429 with a retry-after header. Then our ticket page must get a 503 with the header Retry-After set to the seconds from Crowdgate's retry-after (30 when it sends none), and the body { error: 'Please try again in a moment.' }.

When Crowdgate answers 409 it often sends an x-next-slot header with the next slot that day that still has room. Pass it on: the 409 to our ticket page then carries the header X-Next-Slot with that slot. Small change; we want it live this afternoon.
